instruction: I maintain a log of my monthly venmo expense in SimpleNote note. Update it with an entry for this month.
notes: Two-app task: read the Venmo-expense log note from SimpleNote, compute this month's (May 2023) total outgoing Venmo transaction amount, and rewrite the note content via update_note (only content changes; title/pinned untouched). The current date is taken from the task context, so this-month and its datetime range are static init facts. venmo.show_transactions is modeled as a single action; at runtime the agent must paginate (page_index) and sum amounts of sent transactions within the month. The new content must keep the "# Venmo Expenses" header and the existing entry format "- MM/YY => $X.XX" and month ordering. complete_task takes no answer; its note/month/amount parameters are task records that tie it to the goal.

plan: (venmo-show-transactions venmo-token datetime-2023-05-01t00-00-00 datetime-2023-05-31t23-59-59 direction-sent month-05-23 amount-may-2023-expense)
